title.text: What if everyone could read your mind for 10 seconds?

lines.l03: The quiet kid? Only thinking about pizza.
lines.l04: You're staring at your crush. She heard.
lines.l06: “This meeting could have been an email.”
lines.l07: First date. Both think: “When can I leave?”
lines.l08: A stranger rates your outfit. Badly.
lines.l09: Then it spreads to the whole world.
lines.l10: Every surprise party on Earth: ruined.
lines.l11: Everyone who texted “on my way”… still in bed.
lines.l12: Turns out nobody knows what they're doing.
lines.l16: “Wait… did you all hear what I thought about you?”
lines.l17: What would they hear from you?
